highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.150.8 update fixes native raster-pipeline failures, region allocation, and texture sampling without changing managed APIs.

bullets.detail: Prevents undersized region buffers for subdivided conics and contains failed runtime-shader stage construction instead of executing a partially constructed Raster Pipeline.

bullets.lead: Correct texture uploads and subset filtering
bullets.detail: Disables an unsupported GLES upload format for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx and preserves subset clamps when nearest filtering could sample neighboring texels. Integer-relative one-to-one mappings retain their fast path.
